Plugin.Name: Fabric Routing
Plugin.Overview: FRRouting packages for Unraid (zebra, fabricd/OpenFabric). Pair with Thunderbolt Net for OpenFabric on the Thunderbolt underlay. Settings → Network Settings → Fabric Routing: Download and Install packages. Does not change eth0/br0 by default. Support: Thunderbolt Net forum thread. Bugs: GitHub Issues.
